title: The hidden background noise that can catch criminals
summary: Tom Scott explains Electrical Network Frequency analysis, where hum from the power grid in a recording is matched against grid logs to date and place it. He talks to a researcher and sets them a challenge.
why: The go-to short, accessible explainer for mains hum forensics, linked whenever recording authenticity or timestamps come up.

quote.text: less detailed but pretty accessible video [1] explaining how mains hum forensics work
